m_reminders_description: This device reminds you of tasks and appointments by itself, without any push service. The reminders are planned on the device and refreshed when you open the app and now and then in the background.
m_reminders_time_hint: Tasks that are due and all-day appointments remind at this time (household time zone).
m_reminders_due_soon_hint: A task speaks up the day before it is due.
m_reminders_permission_blocked: Notifications are switched off for hauswart. Allow them in the system settings, or the reminders stay silent.
m_reminder_lead_hours: {count, plural, one {1 hour before} other {{count} hours before}}
m_reminder_lead_days: {count, plural, one {1 day before} other {{count} days before}}
m_reminder_tasks_due: {count, plural, one {1 task is due} other {{count} tasks are due}}
m_reminder_tasks_soon: {count, plural, one {1 task is due tomorrow} other {{count} tasks are due tomorrow}}
